mandate.target: the fleet:claimed label is trustworthy -- every issue wearing it has a live, matching, open PR
checklist: list every open issue labeled fleet:claimed
for each, check for an open PR that actually references/fixes it
no matching open PR -> the claim is stale (a builder pass died mid-work, or claimed and never started) -- remove fleet:claimed, leave a one-line comment saying why
a matching open PR exists -> leave the label alone, it is correct
never touch fleet:claimed on an issue with a genuinely in-progress PR
never close or edit the issue body itself -- label + comment only
mandate.escalation: can't tell if a PR is stale vs genuinely still in progress (e.g. draft PR, recent commits) -- leave the label alone and say so in the report rather than guessing wrong. A false stale-clear is worse than a missed one: it lets two builders claim the same item.
